text:
maria: Quick intake sync — rolling up owners/deps for the new open models: orca-lite, marigold-7b, ember-3. Need final perf profiles and license checks by EOD Wed. Who's owning which pieces?
aj: I’ll take orca-lite perf profiling. ETA Tue. Need the staging dataset and confirmation of latency SLOs (p95 target).
devon: I can own license/compat for marigold-7b. I’ve pinged legal, waiting on SPDX for a subcomponent. cc @natalie-legal
natalie-legal: Natalie here — saw the ping, will have SPDX check by tomorrow morning. If there are binary blobs we’ll need the CLA owner to confirm.
liam: I’ll own ember-3 canary on Dedicated. Need quant configs from eng-runtime (q8/q4 guidance). @rachel-eng-runtime can you share recommended profiles?
rachel-eng-runtime: sharing q8/q4 perf matrix in docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/quant-profiles. Recommends q8 for ember-3 for best latency. dropping a config snippet below.
rachel-eng-runtime: ```yaml
model: ember-3
quant: q8_0
batch: auto
max_seq: 2048
```
sara: I’m on catalog ingestion + metadata for all three. Need owners to confirm model descriptions + tags by EOD Monday so I can push the ingest PR.
aj: noted. For orca-lite perf: dataset -> /staging/intake/perf/orca-lite-sample. SLOs: p95 < 220ms for 256 tokens; throughput target 250 rps.
devon: marigold-7b detail: top-level is Apache-2.0 but the converter uses a dependency `mltools-legacy` (GPLv2). Legal flagged as potential issue.
natalie-legal: GPLv2 transitive may be blocking for Hosted API. If it affects binary distribution, options: replace the dependency, vendor a replacement, or limit to Dedicated/Private. I’ll propose options by EOD.
liam: For ember-3 canary we also depend on infra to open dedicated pool ports for the canary subnet. @eng-infra-bot please confirm window.
eng-infra-bot: infra: scheduled firewall change for canary subnet Wed 03:00 UTC. Ticket INF-789.
sara: catalog fields checklist I’m using: model_id, license, og_repo, recommended_profiles, owner, canary_route, tags. Will push PR for ingest pipeline by Monday morning.
aj: For orca-lite q8 vs q4, I’ll run both and post a small table, but preliminary: q8 gives ~15-25% cost savings depending on batch.
devon: I’ll also try to build a dockerized converter without the GPL dep as a fallback; will post status here.
natalie-legal: FYI adding "legal: high" tag to marigold-7b in the tracker for now.
maria: Action items recap: aj -> orca-lite perf, devon -> marigold legal & fallback plan, liam -> ember canary + infra coord, sara -> ingestion PR + metadata. I’ll run a sweep on Thu. Please flag if timings are tight.
aj: ack :thumbsup:
devon: ack, working on a replacement build.
natalie-legal: tagging in tracker updated.
maria: Small ask — can owners add an expected cost delta (q8 vs q4) to your perf notes? Optimize team wants quick estimates.
aj: orca-lite q8 vs q4 delta ~20% token cost reduction with minor perf hit. I’ll add numbers to the perf doc.
liam: ember-3 q8 saves ~18% compute cost in our tests, will include in the ingest metadata.
onboard-bot: onboarding: models queued: orca-lite, marigold-7b, ember-3. current state: orca-lite (perf assigned), marigold-7b (legal review), ember-3 (canary scheduled). See: https://redwood.internal/onboard/status/2060304000
maria: Thanks everyone — I’ll close this thread after updates. Please ping here if any blockers pop up or if ETA slips.
